raised_by: User-side audit, 2026-10-09; the audit also confirmed all 257 numeric bindings against frozen sources.
audit_conclusion_accepted: The main disclosure concerns are justified; the review is a useful technical follow-up, not the independent cold read originally planned. This matches the review's own independence declaration.

corrections.target: minor 6, section 12, R9, estimand E7, claim-audit interpretation finding
corrections.wrong: Table F compares a mean of facility CIFs with a cohort Aalen-Johansen estimate 'without a note'.
corrections.evidence: paper/main_v0.3.md: Table F caption labels both quantities; section 3.6 names the Aalen-Johansen reference.

corrections.wrong: Section 8 should disclose that the local closure cannot be re-executed by readers.
corrections.evidence: paper/main_v0.3.md sections 3.6 and 8 already disclose that private arrays are not distributed and that public verification is distinct from private-data reproduction.

corrections.target: minor 3, R9, estimand E1, triage SA04
corrections.evidence: docs/track_b/macro_competing_risk_protocol.json: three-class multinomial with no-event reference, seven primary macro predictors, so two cause-specific coefficients per predictor.
corrections.resolution: CORRECTED to 'at least 14 macro coefficients'. 'At least' because the preprocessing contract adds one missing indicator per numeric; whether those are non-constant for macro features cannot be verified from public artifacts.
corrections.origin: Error originated in Task 17 (reports/paper/review/task17_claim_attack_registry.json, build_task17_registries.py, reports/paper/TASK17_HOSTILE_SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW.md) and was carried into Task 20. Task 17 artifacts are part of the published record and are NOT edited here; flagged for the next erratum. paper/main_v0.3.md never makes the error.

corrections.wrong: M1's unseen-vintage default calibration described as 'near-ideal' from a slope of 1.0091.
corrections.evidence: Van Calster et al. 2019 (VanCalster2019, already in the manuscript bibliography): mean and slope establish at most weak calibration; moderate and strong calibration require calibration-curve evidence.
corrections.resolution: CORRECTED to weak-calibration evidence only. M6's substance unchanged.

round_two.source: Packaged user-side audit (task20-review-audit.zip): AUDIT_TASK20.md, FOLLOWUP_CORRECTIONS.md, audit_task20_results.json, audit_task20.py

corrections.wrong: 'At least 14' coefficients, possibly more via macro missing indicators 'not verifiable from public artifacts'; 88 months presented as effective support; 'strengthens the concern'.
corrections.evidence: src/credit_risk/track_b/macro_hazard/models.py builds ':missing' names only for mortgage NUMERIC columns and rejects non-finite macro values; reports/track_b/macro_competing_risk_validation.json#/development/M2/parameters has 37 features, all seven macro terms, six ':missing' columns all mortgage, coefficients 3x37.
corrections.resolution: Exactly 14 cause-versus-no-event macro contrasts and 21 stored class coefficients. Penalized effective df not estimated. 88 distinct months is not an effective sample size; the corrected count does not quantify overfitting strength.

corrections.target: M3, abstract audit sentence 7, claim audit
corrections.evidence: Year within gain +0.00635711 (full primary); month within gain -0.00039862 (eligible subset).

corrections.wrong: Month pair weights 1.979%/98.021% juxtaposed with year contribution shares 1.81%/98.19% as the same quantity.
corrections.resolution: CORRECTED: weights and contributions reported separately for both resolutions.

corrections.wrong: Missing calendar AUC intervals called an internal inconsistency and an arXiv blocker.
corrections.evidence: The section 4.4 decomposition is an exact identity of a fixed observed dataset; v0.3 does not claim macro sampling uncertainty for it.
corrections.resolution: M2 downgraded to MODERATE; disclosure required (R2); interval computation optional (PEER_REVIEW_RESPONSE). arXiv blockers 1 -> 0.

corrections.wrong: 'Only 2020 saw substantial macro movement'; 'M2 is never materially better'.
corrections.evidence: reports/track_b/macro_signal_attribution_stability.json#/macro_shift/regime_macro_summaries/evaluation/2022: mortgage 3.11-7.08, Treasury 1.55-4.02; 2021 delta -0.00608 = -4.5% relative; no registered materiality threshold.
corrections.resolution: Premises withdrawn; both-readings discussion recommendation retained.

corrections.wrong: Default calibration presented as uniformly worse under M2.
corrections.resolution: Full calibration vector required; no blanket claim.

corrections.wrong: Period ranking called economically negligible and not actionable because the calendar is observed.
corrections.evidence: No loss or decision-policy evaluation exists in the study.

corrections.wrong: 'Transport' called the wrong word and in conflict with section 4.5.
corrections.evidence: Prediction-model validation literature uses transportability for performance assessment beyond the development setting (BMJ 2024;384:e074819).
corrections.resolution: Softened to a terminology preference; not to be read as independent external validation.

corrections.target: section 3, abstract audit sentence 1, claim audit
corrections.wrong: Abstract sentence 1 classed TOO_BROAD and the central claim 'C - OVERSTATED as written'.
corrections.evidence: 'Can distinguish' is modal, a possibility the study demonstrates.
corrections.resolution: Reclassified to SUPPORTED with editorial note; scope error withdrawn.

corrections.wrong: Several statements of certainty: 'no target leakage'; 143-pass as independently established; DISTINCTIVE_COMBINATION as unqualified; 'interval' as wrong; decisions as objective.
corrections.evidence: Absence of identified leakage is not proof of an operational information set; the pass-1 working file was not committed; Task 16 conclusion is frozen.
